ui_bugs.issue: On web, captureRef(shareRef, ...) throws 'findNodeHandle is not supported on web. Use the ref property on the component instead.' — the react-native-view-shot 4.0.3 index.js calls findNodeHandle() before delegating to RNViewShot.web.js. Because the exception is caught, users only see 'Impossible de générer l'image. Réessaie.' and no PNG download happens. Reference: /app/frontend/app/quote/[id].tsx:47 and /app/frontend/node_modules/react-native-view-shot/src/index.js:128

integration_issues.issue: PNG export completely broken on web preview; the entire feature #1 of this iteration does not work on web. Both galerie and partager l'image affected.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated prop `pointerEvents="none"` on <View>. Runtime warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Move to style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/quote/[id].tsx:216
Uses `ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images` (deprecated in expo-image-picker; new API is a string array like ['images']). Reference: /app/frontend/app/book/[id].tsx:58,66

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix web image export. react-native-view-shot 4.0.3 breaks on react-native-web. Two options: (a) on Platform.OS==='web', bypass captureRef and call html2canvas directly on the offscreen DOM node — attach a ref callback that stores the raw DOM element (e.g. `<View ref={el => { shareDomRef.current = el; }}>`), then `const canvas = await (await import('html2canvas')).default(shareDomRef.current, { width:1080, height:1350, backgroundColor:null }); const dataUri = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');`. (b) Downgrade / patch react-native-view-shot to a version that supports RN-Web (or use a Web-only alternative such as `dom-to-image-more`). After fix, verify /quote/[id] btn-save-image triggers a PNG download and testID share-feedback shows 'Image téléchargée.'.
Replace `pointerEvents="none"` prop with `style={{ pointerEvents:'none', ... }}` on the offscreen View at quote/[id].tsx:216.
Replace deprecated `ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images` with `mediaTypes: ['images']` in book/[id].tsx photoProgress().
Cosmetic: Google Books 429 — consider a small in-memory cache or a retry-after backoff for /api/books/search to reduce user-visible empty results during peak. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: quote/[id].tsx swallows the captureRef error with a plain `catch {}` — this made triage hard. Recommend keeping a `console.warn` inside the catch so future regressions are visible in dev.

The offscreen ShareQuoteCard container relies on `position:absolute; left:-2000` which works but is placed inside the root View AFTER a ScrollView; html2canvas will still find it when rendered, but any parent transform could break capture. Consider portalling to document.body on web.

server.py: book creation now correctly initializes `sheet: {}` (verified by test_create_book_initializes_empty_sheet). PATCH sheet fully replaces the previous value (partial replace test confirms). This is coherent with the spec but be aware the client must always send the full sheet object.

/api/search: theme filter correctly hides books (per spec) and book_id filter also hides books; user-scoping verified with a second account seeing empty results. Regex escaping of the q parameter should be reviewed to avoid ReDoS on adversarial input (not tested, low priority).

rca_of_issue: CRITICAL — web image export failure. Reproduction: 1) open /quote/{id} in web preview; 2) click testID btn-save-image; 3) observe share-feedback shows 'Impossible de générer l'image. Réessaie.' and NO PNG download occurs. Root cause: react-native-view-shot@4.0.3 exports captureRef from src/index.js which unconditionally invokes findNodeHandle(view). react-native-web's findNodeHandle throws 'findNodeHandle is not supported on web. Use the ref property on the component instead.' This exception propagates BEFORE RNViewShot.web.js (which uses html2canvas) is ever reached. The screen's try/catch then displays the generic error string. Confirmed by instrumenting the catch with console.error; captured stack: findNodeHandle at 65279 → captureRef at 181967 → our capture() at quote/[id].tsx:47. Mitigation (recommended): on Platform.OS==='web', skip captureRef entirely — attach a ref callback to the offscreen <View> that stores the underlying DOM element (`viewRef.current._node` or via `(el)=>{ domRef.current = el; }`) and invoke `html2canvas(domRef.current, { width:1080, height:1350 })` directly, then `.toDataURL('image/png')`. This restores the intended data-uri output on web and preserves native behaviour.
